road-pamir-highway.story: From Dushanbe it runs 1251 km to Dushanbe; allow about 20 h 51 of riding. The stops in between: Sary Tash, Osh and back through Sary Tash. The highest point is about 3,750 m. It crosses from Tajikistan into Kyrgyzstan - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. A steady touring day rather than a sprint.
